title: Pure Mist Royal Mist 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Royal Mist delivers a classic tobacco flavour with smooth, savoury notes and subtle earthy tones. This well-balanced e-liquid is perfect for vapers who prefer traditional tobacco blends with a rich, authentic profile. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers a variety of VG/PG ratios for different vaping preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more pronounced flavour with discreet vapour. Crafted for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Royal Mist is made in the UK with premium ingredients to ensure consistent quality and satisfaction.
